reviews.text:
We had such a wonderful experience! Elizabeth took amazing care of us and our pup. She was incredibly sweet, patient, and informative, making sure all of my questions were answered and that our pup was well taken care of throughout the entire visit.

We’re preparing to travel internationally with our dog, and the process can definitely feel a little overwhelming at times. Elizabeth made everything feel so much easier by walking us through the process, explaining everything thoroughly, and making sure we felt comfortable and informed every step of the way.

You can genuinely tell she cares about both the pets and their owners, and that made such a difference for us. Such a great experience overall, and I would absolutely recommend this hospital!
I will highly recommend coming here! Dr. Youseff is great.They love and care for all my fur babies. Deidra and Whitney are amazing and so helpful!

I went here to get both of my cats seen to get the USDA Health Cert since my husband and I are moving to Germany due to the military. EXCELLENT help!!! They helped ease my worries and were so sweet with both my cats. Elizabeth talked me through the whole process and made sure I had no questions about anything and was just very nice and understanding of my anxiety with the whole situation. I highly recommend them, definitely left feeling better about everything, I can’t thank them enough!!!!!

Thank you so much to the amazing staff at North Star! Everyone was absolutely wonderful and made us feel so welcomed and cared for.

A special thank you to Elizabeth for taking such great care of us and our fur babies We truly appreciate everything you did for us.

I would 100% recommend North Star Animal Hospital to anyone looking for compassionate and caring veterinary care! 🐾❤️
Thank you Northstart animal hospital. Great staff love them all. Thank you so much Elizabeth for all your help we appreciate it very much. 100 out of 100 very much recommend.

I made a appointment with North star Animal Hospital for my two dogs that always have ear and skin problems. Initially i thought I would have two pay for two injections for each dog  . A antibiotic and a cytopoint injections, after examination turns out both dogs just needed cytopoint and no antibiotic shot and only one dog required ear treatment.  Thank you nurse Dedra and doctor Pittman for being so professional and knowledgeable.

Deidra is absolutely amazing! ❤️ My dog has severe anxiety, but she was so patient and caring that he quickly learned to trust her and now goes with her with ease. She treats him like he’s her own and always takes the time to explain his medications and care. We absolutely love Deidra—she’s our #1 vet tech! 🐾❤️
Irma, we appreciate you taking a moment to leave us a 5-Star review. Thank you for supporting our team!

I had a great experience at North Star Hospital from the moment I called to schedule my pet’s appointment to the end of our visit. The process was easy, the instructions were clear, and the staff provided excellent service. They explained all the information I needed to know and made sure I understood what they needed from me.

The appointment itself was quick, smooth, and stress-free, and I really appreciated being able to get everything taken care of without a long wait. The prices were also very reasonable.

A special thank you to Elizabeth for assisting me during the appointment and making the whole experience so easy. I truly appreciate the great service and would definitely recommend North Star Hospital to other pet owners!

We have been coming here for years. We live across town and still come here because of the service and gentle care they provide. Our last visit was with Elizabeth and she was so kind and thorough and very loving with our animal. Definitely recommend this vet.

Dr Youssef and North Star have provided such incredible care for my kitty in her later stages of life and i am so grateful for their guidance and compassion. Deidra, Myra, Whitney, Tanya, and Mariah are such an amazing veterinarian team!

Amazing place, super friendly and knowledgeable staff. Have taken my pup here since he was a puppy and have had no problems. I love Deidra she was so helpful and knowledgeable as well! The front staff was wonderful and Mayra was so nice and sweet

We took our 18 1/2 year old Shi Tzu mix for end of life care. From theoment they held the door  open for us on arrival to thectime we left without her, we felt cared for and comforted. The kind treatment for our fur baby was explained in detail and only proceeded with when we were ready. We were never rushed. Quite the contrary. At every opportunity we were given time to spend with our cutie and proceed when we were ready.
We are so glad we went to North Star Animal Hospital at the recommendation of a family member.
Blessings to everyone who helped us that morning.

I have been going to this vet clinic since 2014, Dr. Youssef is always great, he took care of our yorkie for 9 years. As an ethical breeder, I always trusted his opinions and decisions, we usually discuss the proper course of treatment and cost.

Recently, two of my female coton de tulears had a hard time with their labor and the puppies are overdue. We decided a C-section will be the appropriate procedure. It was nerve wracking but Dr Youssef was very assuring. I also come to know his staff since I have been a long standing client, they were there since I started going to his vet clinic. He is my trusted veterinarian.
Took our jack russell, bandit, had a bad ear infection, the dynamic duo of dr Pittman and Elizabeth did their excellent care. Thanks so much.

The service was excellent. Nurse Elizabeth is very kind and attentive every time we visit. They treat us with excellence and speed. I highly recommend them. Today, Friday, September 11th, I took my baby to the vet, and they were wonderful people. Thank God for Elizabeth and Mayra. I recommend this special place for our pets.

I have been bringing my fur babies since the initiation of North Star Animal hospital.  I have been very pleased with the compassionate top notch care my fur babies have received.  Dr. Youssef is very knowledgeable and will go far and beyond to ensure my fur babies receive the best possible care.   He is very honest and is always looking for the best interests of my fur babies.  The staff is wonderful, Deidra, Mariah and Whitney.  They welcome you with a smile and are very accommodating with scheduling the vet visit.  The facility is clean with reasonable prices.  Please consider this location, you won’t regret it.

From the moment I walked in, I was warmly greeted by the staff-Deiara, Marian, Whitney, and everyone else who has cared for my fur babies.  They are always friendly and genuinely compassionate.  Dr. Youssef is exceptional! He is caring, knowledgeable, honest and always goes above and beyond for his patients.  One day, my fur baby became ill just as the clinic was about to close.  When I called, Dr. Youssef stayed and waited for us so he could examine and treat my little dog.  That level of dedication & compassion meant so much to me and is something I'll never forget.  The quality of care is outstanding and the cost is reasonable.  I truly appreciate everything the team at North Star Animal Hospital has done for my pets.  I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a veterinary team that treats your pets like family.

The team at North Star has taken great care of our kitty Mythos. He has multiple issues and the team has handled him and us with compassion. Deidra and Dr. Youssef have been great at communicating with us every step of the way.

We trusted North Star Animal Hospital from 2018 to 2024 and had great experiences with routine check-ups and standard care. However, starting in 2025 and into 2026, the quality of care took a drastic turn for the worse, marked by blatant price gouging and dangerous misdiagnoses.

We initially brought our dog in for a persistent cough. After running blood tests and X-rays, North Star told us he was fine. When his condition didn't improve, we took him to BluePearl Pet Hospital, where they immediately diagnosed him with pneumonia. We returned to North Star with this information, but rather than addressing the pneumonia, they went completely down the rabbit hole, insisting he had Chagas disease.

For months, we went back to North Star seeking help as our dog's health steadily deteriorated. Instead of providing answers, they sent us on a wild goose chase while charging nearly double the price for medications that we later found on Chewy. While finding a beneficial solution through Chewy, we were later notified that North Star charged $17 per prescription just to authorize it through a third party. They insisted we utilize their in-house pharmacy instead—which was double the cost, as mentioned.

Desperate for real answers, we sought outside veterinary care. By that point, the untreated infection had completely taken over his right lung and was spreading to his left. We were referred to Thrive for an ultrasound, where they drained fluid from his chest for testing. The results revealed the heartbreaking truth: our baby had cancer.

Had North Star not wasted critical months chasing a non-existent Chagas diagnosis, we could have caught the fluid buildup early, drained it, and managed his cancer to keep him comfortable, rather than leaving him to suffer, suffocating, in silence.

North Star has changed entirely over the years, and I cannot recommend them to anyone. If your pet needs serious medical attention, go elsewhere. Both BluePearl and Thrive are exceptional resources that actually listen and provide real care.

I brought my cat to North Star Hospital last Saturday because she was having inconsistent and concerning breathing. I was terrified and honestly panicking at the thought that I might have to say goodbye to my sweet girl.

After speaking with Nurse Deidra and Dr. Pittman, we decided to move forward with X-rays to find out exactly what was happening. The X-rays revealed that she had asthma. I am beyond grateful that they took the extra steps to properly diagnose her instead of assuming the worst. The decision to do the X-ray truly saved my cat’s life. 🐾❤️

Nurse Deidra and Dr. Pittman showed incredible patience, compassion, empathy, and genuine concern—not only for my cat but also for me during one of the most frightening moments I’ve experienced as a pet parent.

My cat was able to come home with medication and has been making progress in her recovery. She is truly my little miracle, and I will forever be grateful to the team at North Star Hospital for helping give her a second chance.

Thank you, Nurse Deidra and Dr. Pittman, from the bottom of my heart. You made a heartbreaking situation feel hopeful, and I will never forget the kindness you showed us. ♥️🐾

My daughter brings her dogs here so when I got my dog I knew this was going to be his vet. He is always so happy after his visits.
The entire staff is great and Deidra is always so great to my dog Chico

I highly recommend this vet. We bring all of our dogs here and they are so great with them. The entire staff takes such great care of our dogs.
We recently adopted another dog who is really anxious at the vet and Dr Yusef recommended “happy visits” to ensure that he gets comfortable with the vet and do not risk traumatizing him anymore. The first time we took our dog in to the vet he didn’t let anyone near him but each time we go he’s been more open to the staff. I want to especially thank Deidra who is so patient and kind with all of our dogs. Our anxious dog loved her immediately and even let her take his leash and walk him to the back all by themselves. Deidra is so great at what she does and we love having her as part of our dog’s care team.

We initially brought our dog here several years ago because we were looking for a new vet, and after that very first appointment, we knew we had found the right place. We have continued coming back ever since because the entire team consistently provides such wonderful care to our dogs.
The staff is truly exceptional, and I especially want to recognize our vet tech, Deidra. She is absolutely phenomenal. Our oldest dog has never liked being picked up and can be very uncomfortable at the vet, but he completely trusts Deidra. He lets her scoop him up like it’s nothing, and seeing how safe and comfortable he feels with her means the world to me. That kind of trust says so much about the way she handles and cares for animals. She is patient, gentle, and clearly has a special connection with the pets she works with.
I also really appreciate the time Dr. Yusef and Dr. Pittman take to talk with me about our dog’s care. They are thorough, compassionate, and make sure I understand what is going on and feel comfortable with the plan.
Sarah, Elizabeth, and the rest of the team at North Star were clear, helpful, and kind. Easy process for obtaining an EU health certificate, and greatly reduced my stress during a big move!

I  was looking for help for my senior dog. This was the only vet that discussed draining my dogs , extra fluids to make him more comfortable. They did the procedure same day in the entire staff with super friendly and understanding about my dog's situation. We will definitely be returning to this vet with our other pets.

We have been taking our three Frenchies (9 year old female, 8 year old male, and 6 year old female) to North Star Animal Hospital for the last six plus years. The veterinarian and his staff are always amazing. From c-section deliveries, asthma attacks, salivary gland surgery, ear infections, stroke, arthritic spine issues requiring laser acupuncture, and most recently removal of mast cell carcinoma…I wouldn’t trust my fur babies with anyone else. I need to add that there are two extra special staff members in the clinic, Whitney and Deidra. They ALWAYS take extra care and have such love for my fur babies. I can never thank them enough.

Dr Youseff has taken care of my dogs for many years. He’s very thorough and considerate. I’ve referred several people to him including my son and sister in law.
He and Dr Pittman are top notch. The staff and assistants have been great.

I always have a great experience with the doctors and staff at this hospital. But we need to give special kudos to Deidra (our favorite tech), she always goes the extra mile while taking care of our babies. She is very polite, great bed manners, professional and very patient with them. I highly recommend this veterinarian hospital.

We have a rescue dog. No one has ever been able to touch. Not any vet. Not any vet tech. Khalee has been sedated for everything. Including a nail trim. Until she met Diedra. She has been patient and kind. She has truly love our dog into submission. She can do any proceedure to khalee. Because khalee loves her and trust her. I had given up and said no more sedation. Now we can get anything done. This place takes care of all our fur babies. Thank you Diedra!

Very kind staff and extremely efficient! They were super accommodating and helped my cat as quickly as they could. Mariah is an excellent vet tech - she was kind, patient, and explained everything really well. Would definitely recommend!

Dr. Y at North Star Animal Care is an absolute hero. My cat swallowed a shoelace that got stuck in both her stomach and deep in her intestines, and it was a life-threatening situation. Dr. Y saved her life. Beyond his incredible surgical skills, what stood out most was how deeply he cared about her. He treated her like his own. I cannot thank him and the staff enough for giving my sweet girl a second chance at life. If you want a vet who truly cares, look no further.

I love the staff here. Everyone is so nice and friendly. Sydney is the best tech ever!
** UPDATED REVIEW**
I can't say enough about the staff and the vets here! Dr.Yousef and Dr. Pittman are absolutely the best!! When my cat Hermione had a super bug, Dr. Yousef personally called me and gave me updates. When one of my dogs passed away Dr. Yousef himself called me and broke the news to me. My cat who was 18yrs old passed away during an off pay week. I tried to apply for every type of credit available I was denied. The doctor seeing me distraught, said no worries needed. My baby was creameated and we brought him back home a week later. I can go on and on about the staff here. Tanya, Elizabeth, Whitney, Nick. Everyone there is amazing!

We are a military family who received orders to move overseas with our two dogs. Anyone who has gone through an overseas military move with pets knows just how stressful the process can be. There were numerous tests, strict timelines, and a tedious amount of paperwork that had to be completed correctly for our dogs to be allowed to travel with us.

We contacted more than 10 veterinary clinics throughout the San Antonio area, and every single one told us they could not help us. Someone finally recommended North Star Animal Hospital, so I gave them a call, and I am incredibly thankful that I did.

From the very beginning, the women at the front desk were extremely kind, helpful, and efficient. Both of our dogs had appointments scheduled within a week of my initial contact with North Star.

Elisabeth, in particular, deserves major kudos. She was EXTREMELY knowledgeable about the requirements for military families moving overseas with pets. She kept me informed every step of the way, explained what was happening, where our paperwork was being sent, and what we needed to do next. She alleviated so much of the stress and fear that comes with knowing that even one mistake could potentially mean leaving a member of your fur family behind.

In the end, we made it safely to our overseas destination with both of our dogs by our side. I truly cannot thank Elisabeth and the entire North Star team enough for their knowledge, efficiency, kindness, and care. I would absolutely recommend them to any military family preparing for an overseas move with pets!
$180+ plus for a 2 minute PHYSICAL exam? Get out of here. It’s CRAZY!!!
Hi Alessandra, thank you for taking the time to give us the highest rating. We always welcome you back!

Brought a sweet stray puppy here just to get microchip checked because they had a collar and no tag on, and sometimes I'm able to find their owner through a chip. I arrived at 11:45am, had to call the number on the door because they keep the door locked for security, that's fine. But I was on the phone with them by 11:50am and told them I just needed a dog checked for a microchip and they said no because they were "closed from noon to 2pm". But it wasn’t even noon yet, and checking microchips doesn't take long, which I told them was all I was there to do. This isn't the first vet I've been to that seems like they don't want to check dogs for chips, even though that's literally one of the easiest, cheapest, most helpful things a vet can do, that doesn't even require the vet themself to do, just any vet tech can do it, but for some reason multiple vets I've been to don't seem to want to do it, including this one. That, or they really go to lunch 10+ minutes early and don't keep to their posted schedule. I don't know why so many vets seem to not want to check chips, my best guess is because it's free, not something they get paid to do, so they don't want to bother with it? Idk. Just very frustrating to have to drive around place to place just to get lost dogs home and for them to be closed not just 2 hours in the middle of the day, but apparently even longer than posted.
Kitty 😺🐈 …

Well this is the first time that I’ve ever had to write a review. I’m mainly doing this because the service I received was nothing but the bottom of the barrel. I went here once back in March with one of my dogs to get serviced as she was urinating often on herself. First time there and as I was in one of the back rooms waiting on the vet and the vet assistant girl was taking care of us for the time being. First she came and told us it would be a certain price and handed me 3-5 pieces of paper. Then I questioned why was it so expensive ($700-$800) AFTER paying the membership ($300 to start) for the top plan. She then said oh well they should’ve taken something off then came back with 3-5 more pieces of paper. After that sitting there confused with all these papers in my hand the vet Mina comes in and gives me a rundown on what was wrong with my dog and recommendations. At that time he was definitely in a rush you can tell so he says that she has a MILD UTI. I was then giving two options one was pay $100-$200 for pills that MIGHT help but no guarantee. Second pay $400 for a shot that would GUARANTEE to fix it. I was told that if I did the first option and it didn’t work I would need to do the second coming back. I choose the 2nd option and ended up paying close to $700 which started at originally a few hundred for their best plan. Two things that I’m complaining about mainly. First they charged $150 for pills that were only $30 online I found out afterwards so I have NO IDEA why the 400% markup. Secondly my dog still urinates on herself and I was told by another vet that it’s because she has a mass on her inner thigh that needs to be surgically removed. Overall this was a terrible experience and now I have to spend more money for a problem that was supposedly GUARANTEED to be fixed. I will not be bringing my other dog nor recommending this place. Oh and even when I called to complain a a week later and cancel my plan the receptionist didn’t care about anything that I had to say about the experience all she said was canceling now you will have a balance that we will immediately charged and hung up. Still months later they see this review and never reached out because they know they were and are in the wrong.

Ended up at this office, when my baby had a blockade. Once they found out how long he had been blocked they got him straight into the procedure, they offered many credit card options. Dr Youssef is an amazing guy along with the staff! Thank you so much for yalls help this will be our usual veterinarian office to go to now!

I would like to thank the veterinarian and nurses for the excellent care they gave my kittens (Bebe, Papa, and Gorda).

A special thank you to Elizabeth for helping me with the requirements (vaccinations and paperwork) so my kittens could travel to another country. I am truly grateful for their excellent service. Thank you.

worst vet ever, took my dogs in because one of my French bulldog had a limp, they were so concerned with the upsell and their $1500 bill that they completely over looked any signs of IVDD. within in 3 hours of visiting this vet, I was at mission hospital ( where I should have started) because my dogs back legs stopped working completely. but I'm so glad that the priority on my my flea-less dogs was upselling me on shots they didn't need. I know there are two doctors there, the lady has always been great and helpful. the guy vet was and probably still is completely useless. thank you doc for the sound advice of " its just a sprain, she just needs to take these pills and it will get better"
I loved the experience, Elizabeth was very helpful when it came to informing us about everything about the requirements and the things we needed

My pup had to be seen for an issue. Staff was attentive and explained the treatment well. Overall good experience and everyone was friendly. If I had to give one critic it would be explain the process a little clearer to first timers. Other than that thank you to the staff for helping my pup. 💓💓
Excellent service! Miss Elizabeth was a true professional and helped me with my dog. The service was super fast. Thank you so much! 🙏🏻♥️

Dr. Pittmann and Elizabeth helped me out so much today with my three pets. They’re very knowledgeable and understanding and they truly so care about my pets and I’m ever so thankful for them and all the staff at NorthStar animal hospital ❤️✨

Dr Youseff, surgery techs Elizabeth & Deidra were awesome when our 11 yr old dog Stormi needed emergency surgery. They saw her last minute on 1st time visit and took Excellent care of her. She healed petfectly & full of energy, big TY!❤️

North Star has been our vet for over a year now. We are so thankful for their care, especially when it came to the end of life for one of our cats. They are transparent with their pricing. They even offer curbside so you can wait from your car.
I absolutely love taking my dogs to Mina's business, such a caring person!
Love that my fur child has a good primary care doctor. We met the staff before I decided she would be entrusted to great care when needed.

Not friendly. Front desk didn't care about any of my concerns and just kept saying ok to everything. The parking also scks I was stuck in between 2 vehicles and had an emergency and couldn't get out. Probably not the clinics fault I couldn't get out but again they didn't care.
Bigger vehicles should park further away from entrance so everyone else isn't stuck with their pets trapped in their vehicle.
We are more than happy wih the attention of our kitty, Calles.  Dr Pittman and Elizabeth were super nice and professional, and the whole staff was excellent. Thank you!!!

Took my car to North Star Animal Hospital for a health certificate in preparation for an upcoming move. Our nurse Elizabeth was very thorough, professional and kind in preparing the documents. Dr. Pittman and the rest of the staff were all very compassionate and caring!!!

I’ve used this clinic for years and justified the higher prices because I believed the care matched the cost. Not anymore. My last visit made it clear that important things were not explained, and services I expected were not actually performed.

**The different staff who answer the phone also seem jaded and consistently unfriendly, which makes everything even worse.

This was the final straw. I won’t be returning, and others should be aware of the declining quality before choosing this clinic.

AQ

We have always had an exceptional experience with the kind receptionists, techs & Dr. Meyer/Dr. Ramsey. Would highly recommend bringing your fur babies here! Cost is very reasonable  compared to other places.

I've had nothing but great experiences with NSAH. I was recommended to go here for my new pup and have made several visits since May. Staff is always welcoming and helpful. Dr. Youssef is very kind and I really enjoy seeing Elizabeth, when we go. She's so informative and caring. Far from where I live, but so worth it!
Horrible service !!! Never go again.

Saved our dogs life! Went there to get an ultrasound because another vet had told us our dogs liver was super swollen. They found that our dogs gall bladder was huge and rushed him into surgery. They moved their whole Saturday schedule around to make sure he got his surgery within the hour! They made sure to take great care of him after the surgery as well!!!!

Dr. Youssef, Dr. Pittman and the entire staff At Northstar Animal Hospital are phenomenal!  They gave my cat “Lucy” the most amazing, wonderful care.  They cared for my girl as if she was their own. They have the expertise, skills, knowledge and more importantly, I believe they truly love the pets that are in their care. And,  not only the pets but the family as well. I can never repay them for how they took My Lucy and I under their wings. I pray blessings over Dr. Youssef,  Dr.Pittman and the entire Staff.

This is my first time here. I meant to go to another place but ended up here... I got the names confused! Well I'm glad I ended up here because it's a great place. The people are so friendly! And they're so professional! The doctor is very friendly and efficient. He certainly knows what he's doing! Same goes for the assistants. They are pros and know how to handle cats. One thing I love is that I was allowed to be in the room. The last couple times, at other veterinarians, my cat was whisked away and I had no idea what they were doing with him. I loved being able to comfort my cat while he was being examined, etc. in summary, I would certainly recommend North Star! 😊

Staff was really friendly & Vet office was clean. But leaving 2 stars because my dog was improperly diagnosed with a mammary gland tumor, it ended up being terminal lymphoma. I opted to get her “mammary gland tumor” removed 2 weeks prior, spent over 1.9K dollars. 2 weeks later went to get her stitches taken out & they took her to the back to get them taken out, then came back to let me know she had stage III mastasis lymphoma that already spread through her lymph nodes & that she only had a few months to live. I wish they would’ve diagnosed her correctly so I could’ve went with another option before spending that money on the surgery, and could’ve possibly spent it on another treatment for her. ):

When we couldn't figure out exactly what was going on with my oldest furr baby Northstar Animal Providers and staff were there keeping us constantly updated with our furr babies status. Keeping us calm throughout the possible devastating results which turned out to be a lie from the Devil himself. I thank God for putting the Northstar Animal Hospital staff in our lives.  My furr baby after what seemed like weeks before he'd  be coming home was a short live period of one drag out week with results. Negative for Cancer! Bladder stones removed and my furr baby is on the road to recovery. Thank you to the Northstar Animal Staff for your patience, understanding and care for our family. I pray blessings over you'll.
Great staff and friendly environment
Awesome staff, very kind ppl and my Tech Brisa is a rockstar!

I've been with Dr. Ramsey for almost 25 years. It's nice to see him back in his old office. His old staff was amazing. His new staff is amazing. He is amazing. He and his staff are helping me through a very difficult time with an unexpected end of life situation. Their caring and patience with me through this has been unending. They truly care about your pet AND you! You are not just money on the books to them. I don't know what I'd do without them. Special thanks to Kristy, Raven and Renee.
Fantastic staff and they were able to get me in on short notice. They offer curbside and in-clinic exams. I’m taking all my pets here.

I cannot put into words how thankful I am for North Star Animal Hospital and the entire team who saved my dog’s life. We were told by another clinic that his condition was terminal, and we were devastated. But from the moment we walked through the doors of NSAH, we were met with compassion, professionalism, and—most importantly—hope.

Dr. Youssef and the staff went above and beyond, exploring every possible treatment option and tailoring a care plan that gave our dog a real chance. Their level of knowledge, communication, and genuine love for animals was evident in every interaction. Thanks to their dedication and expert care, our beloved pup made a recovery we never thought possible.

Today, he’s happy, playful, and back to being the heart of our home—and it’s all because of NSAH. We will never forget what they did for our family. If your pet needs care, especially in a critical situation, this is the team you want by your side.

Forever grateful.

There's so much to say, but I just don't feel like writing it all. Long story short though is that this has been THE BEST vet I've ever visited. Always straight to the point and always willing to work with you. Super informative and so kind. All of the vet techs are awesome and helpful as well!! They make you feel like family and they treat your fur babies as if they were their own! I drive from San Marcos/ Austin area down to get my dogs checked out and their yearly vaccinations. Totally recommend this spot!

UPDATE!
It’s 2025 and they still continue to go above and beyond! Love this crew so much!
This is a great animal care facility,  the vet cares about his patients and explained everything to our satisfaction.

I adopted two of my fur babies from North Star Animal Hospital. They were so well  socialized that I didn’t have any problems, integrating them as a new family members. From day one it felt like they had been a part of the family for years.

I recently just took both my dogs here for teeth cleanings and nail trimmings. Both my pups are very anxious at the vet due to a past bad experience; but all the staff at NSAH were so gentle and understanding. They were able to provide both my pups with comprehensive dental care, and sedation for their anxiety. The doctor was also very sweet! 🩶

DO NOT GO HERE !!! I had the worst experience ever with this vet. You can book an appointment here but they won’t have an exam room for you! I had an appointment IN ADVANCE but when I arrive with my pet they tell me that there is no room open for me. They then offer me curbside service (???) for my visit. I expected that curbside service would mean that my pet would be seen faster so I agreed to it. I waited 30 MINUTES and nobody saw us. I called and they finally sent out this lady, didn’t get her name, but she was so rude and disrespectful! She really tried to argue with me about the situation so at that point I just had them bring me my pet and we left. This is the most incompetent, unprofessional, useless vet place in San Antonio. They clearly don’t prioritize your pet and their health at all.

I had a kitten that was full of life, but his only issue was diarrhea. These people didn’t check him properly and asked to choose from a list of things the vet suggested They irresponsibly gave him a shot he didn’t need and slowly the cat got a fever and died a week later. Do not bring your animal here!! They don’t know what they’re doing. They just want money. Now I had to watch this kitten pass away that  would have lived a longer life if they hadn’t met me and I hadn’t brought them to this place. I thought I was doing the right thing. I paid money to lead the kitten to his death.

I had an absolutely great experience. I had another veterinarian, but they didn't have space for my pup, who was critically ill, said they were a wellness only clinic. North Star Animal Hospital gave me an appointment and my pup is doing great. I changed veterinarians they are now my veterinarian! They put animal health and well being first.

Thank You, Amanda!

Amanda has been assisting my fur baby, Maverick, for quite some time now, and I can’t thank her enough for the love and care she’s shown him. Her kind demeanor and attentive nature are the reasons Maverick only allows her to assist him.

Maverick is very fearful of new people and unfamiliar places. He doesn’t easily trust anyone — but when he fell seriously ill and had to be hospitalized, Amanda was there every step of the way to care for him.
